'''Plucking the Low-Hanging Apple''' is a [[sword form]]. It is used to cut at the neck, the head being the "low-hanging apple." [[Eamon Valda]] used this form at the beginning of his duel with [[Galadedrid Damodred]]. [[Leopard's Caress]] is often used as a following form to take advantage of the traditional, trained responses to Plucking the Low-Hanging Apple.{{ref/book|11|p}}
